arStrings.szText: Brawling Skill: Leap forward and slam down with your weapon.

{c_important}Leap's{/c} Size and damage are increased the further you {c_important}Leap{/c}, up to {c_number}[SF_41 * 100]%{/c} increased Size and {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_LANDING_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Leap{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:LANDING_UPGRADEB}{/c} damage and can be Cast again within {c_number}[{SF_26}]{/c} seconds before the Cooldown begins.

Landing creates an {c_important}{u}Earthquake{/c}{/u} that deals {c_number}{payload:EARTHQUAKE_PAYLOAD}{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}[PowerTag.Barbarian_Earthquake."Script Formula 1"]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Leap{/c} Summons {c_number}[{SF_29}]{/c} Ancients that {c_important}Leap{/c} at a random enemy and deal {c_number}{payload:LANDING_UPGRADEC}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Leap{/c} now Pulls In enemies upon landing.
{c_important}Leap{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_12*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}{buffDuration:SU4_KNOCKDOWN}{/c} second.
